name: "Antipasti" Salad with Prosciutto, Marinated Chickpeas & Mozzarella

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 sticks celery
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ yellow bell peppers
3 (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
½ cup extra virgin olive oil
⅓ cup white wine vinegar
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp honey
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp onion powder

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice shallots into thin half-moons; place in a medium bowl.
Trim celery and cut crosswise into thin pieces; add to the bowl with the shallot.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Mince sun-dried tomatoes; add to the bowl along with the chickpeas, half the dressing (reserving the rest for serving), salt, and crushed red pepper. Stir to combine and set aside to marinate.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed
½ tsp salt
3 pinch crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, halve tomatoes and place on a platter.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers; add to the platter with the tomatoes, keeping them separate.
Medium dice mozzarella and add to the platter.
Cut or tear each slice of prosciutto into 3 pieces; roll each piece and add to the platter.
Add artichokes and olives to the platter.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (170 ml) jars artichoke hearts, marinated
1 cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide mixed greens between plates or bowls. Place a scoop of marinated chickpeas in the center of the greens, then surround with tomatoes, bell pepper, mozzarella, prosciutto, artichokes, and olives. Drizzle with reserved dressing and enjoy!
